policy: Every requirement is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the page named in source_roles. Nothing is inferred.
structure_note: The defining evidence here is not capital alone but capital PLUS an employment effect: the transfer of investment capital and the intended creation of new jobs or securing of existing ones are stated as one requirement.
freshness_note: No dateline is published and the body mentions no year. Tracked by check-source-freshness as '[none published]', the same condition as Singapore's MOM and the US ESTA pages already live.
not_extracted: The economic-benefit assessment. The page describes the authority weighing macroeconomic benefit without stating a measurable threshold, so nothing is recorded as a requirement.

requirements.label: Apply in person at the Austrian representation abroad
requirements.description: The application is lodged personally at the embassy or consulate in the applicant's home or residence country.
requirements.source_excerpt: you are supposed to lodge your application for a red-white-red card personally with the competent austrian representation (embassy or consulate) in your home country or country of residence.

requirements.label: Evidence of transferred capital AND of jobs created or secured
requirements.description: One requirement with two limbs. Capital transferred to Austria is not sufficient on its own; the page ties it to an employment effect.
